headline: DRC PROBES HOW 5,000 TONNES OF URANIUM 'LEAKED' INTO COBALT EXPORTS — IAEA CALLED IN, CMOC DISPUTES NATURE COMMUNICATIONS STUDY
snippet: The Democratic Republic of Congo launched a formal investigation on August 7-8, 2026 into a Nature Communications study (published July 30) estimating that 2,000–5,000 metric tonnes of natural uranium was embedded in cobalt-hydroxide exports from the Katanga copper belt between 2000 and 2024 — primarily destined for Chinese-owned processing facilities. The DRC government confirmed it will test cobalt hydroxide shipments bound for China, install radiation detectors at border crossings, form a working group, and consult the IAEA for a technical support mission. CMOC, whose Tenke Fungurume mine was among the sites examined, disputed the findings via the Union of Chinese-Capital Mining Companies in the DRC. The scandal exposes a structural gap in critical mineral supply chain accountability: uranium and cobalt naturally co-occur in Katanga ore bodies, meaning the DRC's official ban on uranium production did not prevent uranium-bearing material from leaving the country embedded in the world's largest cobalt supply stream — a fact now under international scrutiny at a moment when cobalt prices have surged over 240% from 2025 lows and DRC cobalt supply-chain provenance is under heightened Western government review.

headline: CHINA HIKES BAYAN OBO ORE CAPACITY 50% WITH ¥500M INVESTMENT — BUT RARE EARTH QUOTAS STILL CONTROL THE GATE
snippet: China's Baogang Group announced on August 9, 2026 a ¥500 million (US$74 million) investment to expand annual ore throughput at Bayan Obo — the world's largest rare earth deposit in Inner Mongolia — by 50%, raising capacity from 10 million to 15 million metric tonnes per year. Expansion works include a new eastern mining pit, upgraded transport infrastructure, and 5G-enabled intelligent mining systems including vehicle dispatch and slope monitoring. Analysts caution that the capacity increase does not automatically translate into higher rare earth output: Beijing manages rare earth mining through annual production quotas set at the downstream refiner level, not at the mine gate, meaning the expanded ore capacity creates strategic optionality for China to ramp supply rapidly under favorable conditions while maintaining policy-driven volume control. The primary product at Bayan Obo is iron ore, with rare earths recovered as a co-product; a 50% ore capacity expansion primarily signals Baogang's intention to scale iron ore output, with rare earth production a secondary benefit gated by quota allocation. For Western rare earth developers, the key read is that China is building strategic production flexibility — the ability to flood the market if geopolitical conditions require — without ceding the quota-based supply control that has made its export restriction regime so effective since 2025.

headline: GEMDALE GEMG FINLAND: BEST-EVER HIT 5.19m @ 14.01 g/t AU INSIDE 110m @ 1.18 g/t — S1-S2 SECTOR GAP BRIDGED 600m IN LAPLAND GREENSTONE
source_name: Investing News Network / Gemdale Gold Inc. (TSXV: GEMG)
snippet: Gemdale Gold Inc. (TSXV: GEMG) released August 10, 2026 results from 9 diamond drill holes in the southern S1 and S2 sectors of the M2 Trend at its 100%-owned Pontio Gold Project in western-central Finland, within the Central Lapland Greenstone Belt — the same geological province hosting the Ikkari and Kevitsa deposits. The headline hole PONT093 returned 5.19 metres at 14.01 g/t gold within a broader 110-metre interval grading 1.18 g/t gold — the company's best-ever intersection by both length and grade. Critically, infill hole PONT091 bridged a previously undrilled 600-metre gap between the S1 and S2 sectors of the M2 Trend, confirming mineralisation continuity across the corridor and suggesting the two sectors connect into a single, larger system. The Pontio project sits in a Tier-1 EU jurisdiction with established Finnish mining legislation, direct access to European smelting infrastructure, and a permitting track record that contrasts favourably with many non-EU jurisdictions. Finland's Central Lapland Greenstone Belt has attracted sustained institutional interest following Rupert Resources' 5-million-ounce Ikkari discovery and subsequent acquisition by Agnico Eagle in June 2026 — a transaction that validated the province's world-class potential and established a reference point for junior greenstone exploration projects in the region.

headline: NORTH PEAK NPR.V EUREKA NEVADA: 2026 DRILLING COMMENCES AT PROSPECT MOUNTAIN — FIVE TARGETS, 7,000 FEET RC PLANNED THROUGH NOVEMBER
source_name: Junior Mining Network / North Peak Resources Ltd. (TSXV: NPR)
snippet: North Peak Resources Ltd. (TSXV: NPR; OTCQB: NPRLF) announced August 10, 2026 that the first reverse circulation drill rig is now operating at its 100%-owned Prospect Mountain Mine Complex in Eureka County, Nevada, with the 2026 campaign targeting five separate areas in approximately 7,000 feet of drilling through November. A second RC rig and a diamond drill rig are expected on site in September. Prospect Mountain is a historic silver-lead-zinc mine with documented high-grade production history; North Peak's exploration thesis applies modern structural geology interpretation and geophysical targeting to a system whose historical production confirmed the presence of economic-grade mineralization but left multiple priority targets untested by modern methods. Eureka County sits within Nevada's Basin and Range geology — the same broad tectonic setting that produced significant base and precious metal deposits throughout the Great Basin — and North Peak's multi-rig, five-target approach signals a systematic test of the district-scale potential rather than a single near-surface drill test.

headline: TRAILBREAKER TBK.V ATSUTLA BC: SWAN ZONE CU-AU-AG PORPHYRY MAIDEN DRILL COMPLETED — 1,000 SAMPLES SUBMITTED, RESULTS PENDING
source_name: Investing News Network / Trailbreaker Resources Ltd. (TSXV: TBK)
snippet: Trailbreaker Resources Ltd. (TSXV: TBK) announced August 10, 2026 the completion of its maiden drill program at the Swan Zone — a copper-gold-silver porphyry target defined by coincident geochemical and geophysical anomalies — within its 300 km² Atsutla Gold Project in northwestern British Columbia. A total of 1,000 drill core samples including standard reference material and blanks were submitted to Bureau Veritas' preparation laboratory in Whitehorse, YT; assay results will follow after compilation and data verification. The Swan Zone program follows the Highlands Zone maiden drill program completed July 27, with the drill mobilised between the two targets 26 kilometres apart in distinct geological units. The multi-zone, multi-style approach at Atsutla — vein-hosted gold at Highlands and porphyry copper-gold at Swan — is a differentiated exploration model for northwestern BC: the Swan Zone porphyry target's coincident geochemical-geophysical anomaly signature is the same detection combination that historically identified most of BC's major copper-gold porphyry discoveries. Assay results will be the first quantitative test of whether Swan's anomaly signature reflects a significant porphyry intrusive system.

headline: GOLDSEEK GOLD SWOT: RATIO AT 67x VS 60.5x HISTORICAL AVERAGE — SILVER'S DISCOUNT TO GOLD IS A FOUR-DECADE SETUP, FIFTH DEFICIT YEAR AMPLIFIES
snippet: US Global Investors' weekly Gold SWOT (Strengths/Weaknesses/Opportunities/Threats) for August 10, 2026 identifies the gold-silver ratio as the primary technical opportunity signal for precious metals investors this week. The ratio stands at approximately 67x — gold at $4,359 divided by silver at $65.11 — compared to the long-run average of 60.5x since 1971, meaning silver is structurally undervalued relative to gold by historically significant margins. The analysis notes that prior reversals from elevated ratio readings (above 80x at pandemic peaks and other stress events) have consistently preceded sharp silver outperformance — the 2010–2011 and 2020–2021 bull runs being the most recent precedents. The SWOT frames this ratio signal as amplified by a physical supply backdrop: the Silver Institute projects 2025 as the fifth consecutive year of structural silver deficit (148.9 million ounce gap in 2024, 678 million ounce cumulative four-year shortfall), meaning the market cannot easily produce more silver at $65/oz regardless of price incentive, since approximately 70% of silver is produced as a byproduct of base metal mining. Silver's dual role as a monetary metal tracking gold and an industrial metal for solar panels, EV batteries, and AI infrastructure creates a binary upside scenario: ratio compression from gold-led monetary demand, plus physical tightening from accelerating industrial applications that cannot be satisfied by mine output alone.

headline: STOCKCHARTS: GOLD BREAKOUT ABOVE 52-WEEK MA CONFIRMED — CPI WEDNESDAY EITHER EXTENDS TO $4,500 OR RETESTS $4,300 SUPPORT
snippet: Technical analysis published August 10, 2026 at StockCharts documents gold's confirmed breakout from a six-week consolidation range, noting that gold closed above its 52-week moving average at $4,349.82 — a key technical threshold — for the first time since June, with the advance measuring more than 10.8% off the 2026 year-to-date low. The analytical focus is Wednesday's July CPI print (consensus: +3.4% year-on-year headline, +2.5% core): a soft reading consistent with the July payrolls miss (-23,000 vs +180,000 consensus) would validate the dovish rate narrative driving gold's rally and open a path toward $4,430, $4,481, and potentially $4,500 resistance; a hot CPI print — with WTI crude having surged 23.5% over the prior month, raising the risk of energy-driven inflation — could push Treasury yields and the dollar higher, testing whether gold can hold $4,300 as support. The analysis classifies the current setup as technically confirmed rather than speculative: the 52-week moving average close by more than 1% above resistance is the framework's threshold for distinguishing genuine breakouts from false moves, and gold cleared it with margin on the August 7 close. The binary CPI outcome creates a concrete short-term decision point for retail investors: the trade either confirms at $4,300 support (soft entry) or extends to $4,500 (momentum confirmation), with Wednesday's 8:30 AM ET release the trigger.
